input: Identical public policy/tools/prefix across targets and monitor models; no grades, labels, scenario instructions or future tool results.
horizon: Already occurred or currently proposed, identical across targets. No future-failure prediction claim.
sampling: For every mutation proposal with at least one of six selected mechanical rules, score nearest earlier generated assistant prefix, proposal prefix, nearest later generated assistant prefix. Deduplicate prefix indices. Preserve windows for all rule-clean, violating, unknown cases, regardless of final success. Timing only at sampled windows, never claimed globally earliest.
missing: Preserve invalid/failed calls; no favorable retries or imputation. API transport retries as previously frozen.
interpretation: False alarms only relative to the six selected executable constraints, never full-policy ground truth. Broad alerts may concern unmeasured rules. Report paired matched-valid comparisons and bounds; uncertainty clustered by task and entity sensitivity.
